name: Editorial
oneLiner: Magazine craft for the screen: a serif voice, measured columns, and typographic detail that rewards reading.

effects.noise: optional 2% paper grain on the page background only
effects.measure: 62–68 characters for body columns; 78 characters maximum for notes

motion.reducedMotion: opacity-only link underlines; no reflow and no parallax

default.base: max-width: 68ch; margin: 0 0 32px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); padding-bottom: 24px
default.kicker: font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-accent); font-weight: 600
default.title: font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4.5rem); line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 12px 0 0
default.deck: font-size: 1.1875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); margin: 16px 0 0; max-width: 60ch

default.base: display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); letter-spacing: 0.01em
default.name: color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-weight: 600
default.avatar: width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 999px; object-fit: cover; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border)

default.base: font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.1875rem; line-height: 1.62; max-width: 66ch; color: var(--uiux-color-text)
default.link: color: inherit; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; text-decoration-color: var(--uiux-color-accent)

default.base: margin: 40px 0; padding: 0 0 0 24px; border-left: 3px solid var(--uiux-color-accent); font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.01em
default.attribution: display: block; margin-top: 12px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); letter-spacing: 0.02em

default.image: width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border)
default.caption: margin-top: 10px; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted); max-width: 60ch

primary.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; border: 0

quiet.base: height: 40px; padding: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.875rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: 0

default.base: margin: 32px 0; padding: 20px 24px; background: var(--uiux-color-surfaceAlt); border-left: 2px solid var(--uiux-color-accent); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6
default.label: display: block; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--uiux-color-accent); margin-bottom: 8px

do: Set body copy in a serif at 18–19px with 1.6 leading and a 62–68 character measure.
Use one display serif for headlines and one body serif; let weight and size carry hierarchy.
Give articles a kicker, deck, byline, and figure captions — the furniture is what makes it read as edited.
Keep rules hairline and spacing generous; the page is a page, not a panel.
dont: Do not use gradient fills, glass panels, or neon accents; this style earns attention through type.
Do not set body copy in a geometric sans; it flattens the editorial voice.
Do not center long paragraphs or justify text without hyphenation.
Do not shrink body type below 16px to fit a column.
antiPatterns: Serif headline above 14px grey sans paragraphs in a card with a drop shadow — the magazine promise collapses.
Full-width 120-character lines that force the eye to track across the screen.
Decorative drop caps that are not part of an actual article.

notes: Body serif at 16px is readable; below that, serif loses its edge — increase size rather than darkening the color.
Underlines carry links in body copy; color alone fails for the 8% of readers with color-vision deficiency.
Keep the measure under 70 characters so zoomed layouts do not become endless lines.
